facts.text: Austin Peay State University is the only Tennessee university to offer in-state tuition rates to all military-affiliated students nationwide, including active-duty personnel, veterans, reservists, and eligible family members.

sources.title: Military Support and Resources for Students and Spouses
sources.quote: Austin Peay State University is now the only Tennessee university to offer in-state tuition rates to all of the nation's military-affiliated students, which includes active-duty military personnel, veterans, reservists, National Guard members and their eligible family members.
